description: Grant document or project access to one recipient identified by exactly one userId, email, or phone value. Requires sharing access and sends invitation notifications. Returns the share ID, recipient, role, and status. Use update_share for an existing grant; this does not add organization members.

id.description: Document or project ID selected by target; not a share ID.

userId.description: Recipient’s existing Docmino user ID, not a workspace ID.

email.description: Recipient email address for the invitation notification.

phone.description: Recipient phone number, including its country calling code.

recipient.description: Exactly one recipient identifier: userId, email, or phone. Inviting sends notifications.

role.description: ADMIN grants management access, EDITOR editing access, VIEWER viewing access to the shared target.

target.description: DOC for a document ID; PROJECT for a project ID.

name: invite_share
title: Invite Share
